FEAT-6-S112.title: Consent Schema and Data Contract Definition
FEAT-6-S112.description: Define Pydantic models and MongoDB schema contracts for consent tiers, consent timestamps, audit fields, and de-identification flags to standardize data handling across services.

FEAT-6-S113.title: Consent API Endpoints and Tool Integration
FEAT-6-S113.description: Expose consent workflow through FastAPI endpoints and tool_router integration, enabling the LLM tool-use loop to trigger consent capture, tier escalation, and consent status checks.

FEAT-6-S114.title: Consent Workflow Test Coverage
FEAT-6-S114.description: Implement unit and integration tests validating tier assignment, de-identification enforcement, storage eligibility, and failure scenarios (missing consent, downgrade cases).

FEAT-6-S115.title: Cross-Service Integration with Lead Capture and Unknown Question Flow
FEAT-6-S115.description: Integrate ConsentService with lead_capture and unknown_question services to ensure consent gating is enforced before storing identifiable data and that de-identification is applied consistently across flows.
